cases.name: azure-gpt-4-turbo -> gpt@4{turbo} (host stripped, version 4, turbo modifier)

provenance.ref: ParseFamilyDetailed(raw=, id=azure-gpt-4-turbo) -> (gpt,'',4,turbo); the serving-host 'azure-' prefix is stripped for decomposition so the tuple is host-independent

mutation.description: host-prefix strip yields the host-independent (family,variant,version,mod) tuple, converging with the plainly-served gpt-4-turbo

cases.name: azure-gpt-4o -> gpt/4o (host stripped, 4o is a VARIANT not a version)

provenance.ref: ParseFamilyDetailed(raw=, id=azure-gpt-4o) -> (gpt,4o,'',''); 4o is an alphanumeric line designator (VARIANT), never a dotted version

mutation.description: host-prefix strip preserves the 4o variant; must not promote 4o to version

cases.name: azure-gpt-4o-mini -> gpt/4o{mini} (host stripped, 4o variant + mini modifier)

provenance.ref: ParseFamilyDetailed(raw=, id=azure-gpt-4o-mini) -> (gpt,4o,'',mini); host strip + 4o variant + trailing mini modifier

mutation.description: host-prefix strip preserves 4o variant and the trailing mini modifier
